Bachelor of Engineering in Aeronautics and Astronautics

researchInterests: Computational fluid dynamics, data-driven turbulence modeling, large eddy simulation, and nonlinear dynamics.

researchExperience.institution: Kyushu University, Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics
bullets: Trained nonlinear subgrid-scale (SGS) closures using Tensor Basis Neural Networks in PyTorch on filtered high-resolution large eddy simulation (LES) data and coupled them into OpenFOAM (C++) via LibTorch for a posteriori turbulent channel-flow LES at Reτ = 395.

Demonstrated against direct numerical simulation reference data that a reduced four-tensor basis reproduces mean velocity and total Reynolds shear stress profiles comparably to the full ten-tensor basis.

Introduced a physical-role grouping analysis for basis tensors, showing that dominant groups maintained closely aligned time-averaged contributions across both bases (cosine similarity 0.984–0.998) despite substantial variations in individual learned coefficients.

researchExperience.role: Project Developer, Fukuoka Mitou Program (Advisor: Prof. Takashi Okayasu)
bullets: Designed and implemented Tellmee, a multi-agent LLM assistant integrating IoT sensor readings, agronomic manuals, and growers' observations for strawberry cultivation; the prototype later transitioned to commercial integration with SERAKU Co., Ltd.

Implemented retrieval using Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) and crop growth-stage filters, and compared recommendations with and without growers' observations, showing that incorporating field notes enabled more symptom-specific guidance.

presentations: Nakanishi, S., Kihara, H., and Abe, K., “A Study on Nonlinear SGS Models for LES Based on the Tensor Basis Neural Network Using Machine Learning,” The Japan Society for Aeronautical and Space Sciences (JSASS) Western Branch Conference, Fukuoka, Japan, 20 Nov 2026 (Oral presentation).

Nakanishi, S., Sato, S., Okayasu, T., and Mochida, K., “Development of an AI to Support Beginner Farmers by Integrating Environmental Data and Farmers' Insights,” Annual Conference of the Japanese Society of Agricultural Informatics, Kyoto, Japan, 25 May 2025 (Oral presentation).

leadership.role: Avionics Team Member (Contributed to the development of five rockets)
bullets: Consolidated three microcontrollers into one, designed the club's first CAN bus network, and modularized flight software, enabling parallel device development and shortening integration across subsequent launches.
Built and operated flight telemetry for a launch reaching 3,431 m, verifying barometric separation triggers and providing splashdown GPS coordinates to the recovery team.

Led the avionics team developing the oxidizer flow-regulation valve control system and embedded safety circuitry used in two ground hot-fire tests (video) and in flight; authored launch safety documentation approved by faculty reviewers.
